sampling.method: EXHAUSTIVE over the corpus root's git-tracked files; no sampling, no random draw
sampling.floorReference: the project's stated 200+-file-per-family census floor; this census is over the whole admitted set
sampling.filesOverSizeCapSkipped: tracked files > 512 KiB are skipped by the same rule script/m14/ontology-coverage-gate.ts uses

routing.note: files with a graphql extension that detectLanguageFromPath does NOT route to this lane

gql-absinthe/test/support/fixtures/fake_definition.graphql: "# An image url. Configure image with options: `imageCategory"

constructibility.note: question 1 of the six (EXISTS), measured through the SAME production parseFile over the lane's own tracked fixtures. `corpus` is the count on real code; `fixture` is the count on a file that provokes the family. corpus 0 / fixture > 0 is a live branch the corpus happens not to reach — NOT dead code and NOT a correct ruling, and the two are indistinguishable without this block.
constructibility.noteFixtureRunner: script/m14/run-fixtures.ts:678 calls analyzer.analyze() directly, so a passing m14 fixture does NOT establish production emission; this block does.
